articles.title: Tenants need £75k income to rent in London – claim
articles.summary: This is according to Propertymark, the letting agents’ trade body
articles.ai_summary:
- A report by Propertymark reveals that tenants need an annual income of £75,000 to afford renting in London.  
- The alarming figure highlights the increasing financial strain on renters in the capital amidst rising housing costs.

articles.ai_summary:

articles.title: Landlord taxes fail to invigorate local markets – claim

articles.ai_summary:
